text: Two record weeks. I'm thinking about a third oven. Sato quoted ¥1.2M and wants a ¥350,000 deposit. Pay the deposit to Sato Kitchen Service.
I can't pay that deposit — it's over the ¥100,000 limit. You'll need to approve it or adjust the limit first.
Right — that one is mine to decide. Let's see October's numbers first.
October's flour cost will be about ¥140,000 more than September's (8% increase on ¥1.72M).
